title: Debounced save uses POST while the frozen spec and the file's own comment describe PUT as the save verb
evidence:
.fetch(draftUrl, {
          method: "POST",  (saveNow, line 193-194) — vs spec line 47: "Debounced `PUT /apply/:code/draft` upserts `(vacancy, email)`" and form_draft.js:226 "// the route accepts POST beside PUT for exactly this reason."
detail: saveNow POSTs, so the beacon's POST is not the exception the line-226 comment (and router comment) implies; the frozen I/O matrix says PUT. Router maps both verbs to the same handler, so purely documentary drift.
recommended_fix: Switch saveNow to PUT (beacon stays POST), or amend the spec line and comments to say the saver POSTs and PUT is kept for the beacon-compatible pair.
